# asset: # what the overlay is: the Option / Key Configuration menu, a package of code and strings only (stage-zero file 20100 = group 2, hundreds 1, index 0; load address 0x801D4000). Its one entry point is optionsUpdateMenuTask, called by main's uiUpdateOptionsAfterLoadTask once the CD queue is idle (src/main/ui.c:3187-3198). Loaders: title:_titleInitializeScreenTask (title.c:243, for the title's Configuration entry, which opens the one-row vibration list through main's _uiVibrationOptionsTask, textdraw.c:1514), gameplay:menuRootTask (menu_root.c:508, a direct options request) and gameplay:itemMenuDrawOptionsCommandRow (menu_actions.c:356, when the cursor reaches Option in the in-game menu). All three use the MENU profile; the file has no image, so the offsets move nothing.

# checklist: none of the 86 lines is used by options code. They are the files that share hundreds 1 of group 2 with the package: 20101..20132 are gameplay's weapon preview files (index = weapon item id - 0x7F), 20160/20161 main's disc-change prompts and 20162 the copy of the interface sheets ending reloads. What options code itself reads is main's ui/sheet/image (button glyphs), ui/sheet/palette row 0, the font and three menu sounds - the first six lines.

# weapon preview index gaps: ids 0x85..0x87, 0x89, 0x91 and 0x97 have no name in gItemDescriptors and no file (20106..20108, 20110, 20118, 20124); a request for one resolves to no sector and loads nothing (src/main/fs.c:482-486, :544).
